title: ClearPath Upgrade Pricing Rule and Phased Step-Up
content:
How the upgraded rate of a ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement moving from ClearPath Essentials to ClearPath Standard is built follows the upgrade pricing rule, which reads the agreement's renewal count and the whole months from its go-live date to today. The upgraded rate it starts from is the ClearPath Standard list rate of 124.00 reduced by the ClearPath Standard term discount for the current term (0 percent for 12 months, 2 percent for 24, 4 percent for 36), rounded half up to the cent.

**Rule.**
1. In the initial term (renewal count 0) after 24 or more months live, the step-up is phased and the rate is the current per-seat rate plus 50 percent of the gap between it and that upgraded rate, rounded half up to the cent.
2. In a renewal term (renewal count 1 or more) after 24 or more months live, the rate is the current per-seat rate plus the difference between the ClearPath Standard list rate and the agreement's own tier list fee per seat, but never more than that upgraded rate less 3.0 percent, rounded half up to the cent.
3. Otherwise the rate is that upgraded rate.

A whole month between two dates is counted only once the later date reaches the same day of the month as the earlier one, and a month window of N months ending today takes the entries dated fewer than N whole months before today.

**Worked figures (hypothetical: an upgraded rate taken as 120.00 for illustration, and the ClearPath Essentials list fee of 89.00, so the list-rate difference is 35.00).**

| Current per-seat rate | Renewal count | Whole months live | Rate built |
|---|---|---|---|
| 80.00 | 0 | 30 | 80.00 plus 50 percent of the 40.00 gap, that is 100.00 |
| 80.00 | 2 | 30 | the lesser of 80.00 plus 35.00 (115.00) and 120.00 less 3.0 percent (116.40): 115.00 |
| 90.00 | 2 | 30 | the lesser of 125.00 and 116.40: 116.40 |
| 80.00 | 0 or more | 20 | 120.00 |
